openings.claim: Convert an omitted item into a visible residual: pre-count the exact materials for a bounded batch of assigned patterns, then require its material pool to be empty before sealing those envelopes. An assembly omission leaves an item that commands a batch check.
openings.delta: Tray tags identify materials and samples describe contents; neither makes omissions produce a release signal. Add residual reconciliation using existing supplies and tally sheets. Evaluate a proposed probe; timely, complete delivery of all 60 kits remains unproven.
openings.prediction: With accurately counted batch supplies, an item skipped during filling produces a residual before sealing, enabling the two volunteers to restore it without changing specified quantities or dimensions.
openings.rival_prediction: The nearest alternative is local loose staging alone, suggested by O4. It predicts fewer picking omissions without reconciliation, but supplies no distinct stop signal when a filling omission still occurs.
openings.defeat: A correctly pre-counted batch containing an omission reaches an empty pool because another envelope receives an extra item. Such compensating errors defeat residuals as a sufficient completeness check.
openings.probe: Within the existing table and the same two-volunteer, 90-minute assembly budget, stage at most twelve kits with the actual pattern mixture. Before sealing, briefly leave one required item unfilled, verify whether its residual identifies the affected batch, and restore it. Record reconciliation time and inspect individual contents. Stop expansion if footprint or projected total time fails the constraints; make no purchases.
assumptions: Exact pattern quantities are recoverable from existing specifications or samples.
A staged batch fits the existing table; O4 does not establish its footprint or comparable pattern mixture.
Pre-counting is accurate; counting errors can create false residual alarms, and extras can cancel omissions.
Reconciliation can fit the total 90-minute deadline; no timing benefit is established.
